extName.message: Slopster: Translate Posts & Draft AI Replies on Reddit, X & Facebook

extDescription.message: Translate for free, no sign-up. Draft replies in your own voice with your own AI key, then edit and post them yourself.

personasIntro.message: A persona is the voice you reply in. It holds no product or promotion data.

personaIdentityHint.message: Who you are. Drafts use it to guide wording and never invent experience beyond it.

personaDefaultUndeletable.message: The default persona cannot be deleted

personaNameRequired.message: Enter a name; changes are not saved until then.

personaDeleteConfirm.message: Delete the persona "$1"? This cannot be undone.

apiKeysNote.message: Keys are stored on this device only and never sync to your other devices.

operatorLanguageHint.message: Pages are translated into this language, and reply drafts include a review copy in it.

aiFallback.message: Use the AI engine when Google translation fails

intentLabel.message: What do you want to say?

intentPlaceholder.message: Optional: the point you want this reply to make.

generateUnavailableHint.message: Reply drafting becomes available once you open a post on Reddit, X, or Facebook.

replyNoThread.message: No post found on this page. Open a post on Reddit, X, or Facebook, or click a reply button on the page.

replyUnparsed.message: The model's output could not be read. The raw output is shown below, and filling is disabled.

replyOverLimit.message: The reply is over X's $1-character limit. Shorten it before sending.

replyFilled.message: Filled. Review it on the page and send it yourself.

replyFillNotFound.message: No reply box found. Open the reply box on the page, then try again.

replyFillRejected.message: The page did not accept the text. Copy it and paste it instead.

replyManualSendReminder.message: The extension only fills the reply box. Review the text and send it yourself.

postIntentPlaceholder.message: Optional: what the post should say or ask.

postNoTarget.message: No new-post form is open on this page. Open it first: on Reddit, the subreddit's "Create post" page; on X, the post composer; on Facebook, "Create post" or "Write something" in a group or page.

postVerdictNo.message: Better not to post this here.

postOverLimit.message: The post is over X's $1-character limit. Shorten it before publishing.

postFilled.message: Filled. Review it on the page and publish it yourself.

postFillNotFound.message: The new-post form is not open on this page, or the page changed. Open the form again, then try again.

postManualPublishReminder.message: The extension only fills the new-post form. Review the text and publish it yourself.

translateInputPlaceholder.message: Paste text to translate into your language.

translationTruncated.message: (The text was too long; only the beginning was translated.)

errorMissingApiKey.message: No API key is set for the selected engine. Add one in Settings.

errorRateLimited.message: Too many requests. Wait a moment and try again.

errorHttp.message: The service returned an error. Check the API key and model, then try again.

errorNetwork.message: Network error. Check your connection and try again.

errorBadResponse.message: The service returned an unexpected response.

errorUnsupportedEngine.message: The selected engine does not support this action.

errorNotFound.message: This item was changed or deleted in another window. The list has been refreshed.

personasResetConfirm.message: The saved personas cannot be read. Replace them with a fresh default persona? This cannot be undone.
